{{Top|leg}}
'''Micro-repulsor chips''' were miniature [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] fitted to the inside of [[T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor]]s. The pulsating waves they gave off cushioned the animal inside the conveyor, simulating an owner's hand stroking the pet.
